g.title: SolMap
g.text: Organizers are the centres of each system. Edges show data, direction, and type. Source: Docs/FLOWS.md, Docs/DECISION_TREES.md

g.title: cluster_player
g.text: Routes input to player components. Implements IPlayerContext. Owns the state dictionary.

g.title: cluster_move
g.text: One is active at a time. Chosen each FixedUpdate by priority.

g.title: cluster_cam
g.text: Turns look input into camera rotation. Locks the cursor.

g.title: cluster_combat
g.text: Weapon state, attack timing, animation phases

g.title: cluster_stats
g.text: Single source of truth for stat values and modifiers

g.title: cluster_prog
g.text: Player choices: talent nodes, points, reset

g.title: cluster_ui
g.text: Opens and closes panels. Pauses time. Requests saves on close

g.title: cluster_save
g.text: Decides when to save. Builds the save data

g.title: cluster_time
g.text: Owns time, day, season, year. Broadcasts changes

g.title: PC
g.text: MonoBehaviour on Player. OnJump, OnMove, OnRun, OnLook, OnAttack, OnToggleWeapon

g.title: VC
g.text: Moves a cursor from mouse or navigation. Synthesizes clicks into UI Toolkit

g.title: PCSTATE
g.text: string to object. JumpPriority, IsGrounded, IsRunning, IsWeaponDrawn, IsAttacking

g.title: PCSVC
g.text: Type to service. GetService T for components

g.title: JUMP
g.text: Impulse jump and double jump. Cooldown 0.1 s, priority window 0.15 s

g.title: MOVE
g.text: Grounded and air movement. Sets Rigidbody.linearVelocity. Sticky force when grounded

g.title: CAM
g.text: ICameraController. Pitch clamp -80 to 80. Yaw used by Movement

g.title: CSC
g.text: ICombatController. Sheathed, Unsheathed, transitions. Attack cooldown 0.8 s

g.title: PAC
g.text: Writes animator parameters from state values

g.title: GC
g.text: Sphere or ray cast each FixedUpdate. Coyote 0.15 s. Writes IsGrounded

g.title: RB
g.text: linearVelocity, AddForce. Written by 4 components (finding F2)

g.title: SS
g.text: IStatsService. GetStat, ApplyOrReplaceModifier, RemoveModifiersFromSource. Dirty cache

g.title: RUNMOD
g.text: Adds MoveSpeed modifier while run is held (source PlayerRunning)

g.title: ADISP
g.text: Routes animator event names to IAnimationEventReceiver

g.title: AEH
g.text: Animation events only. Hits come from WeaponHitbox (blade trigger)

g.title: GRAV
g.text: Applies gravity each FixedUpdate. Terminal velocity clamp. Reads stats

g.title: GL
g.text: MonoBehaviour. Listens to a GameEvent, calls RequestLazySave

g.title: MODG
g.text: Collider trigger. Adds GravityMultiplier modifier on enter, removes on exit

g.title: MODZ
g.text: Collider trigger. Sets custom gravity direction

g.title: MODS
g.text: Collider trigger. Adds MoveSpeed modifier from RunMultiplier

g.title: ROT
g.text: Spins props, optionally faces camera. Not player state

g.title: TTC
g.text: Click handling for talent nodes. Enforces prerequisites and dependents

g.title: PS
g.text: IProgressionService. Talent pool and attribute points. SpendTalentPoint, RefundTalentPoint

g.title: TSS
g.text: ITalentStateService. Allocated points per node. Raises talent GameEvent

g.title: TEV
g.text: ScriptableObject. Raised on any allocation change

g.title: SM
g.text: ISaveManager. 2 s debounce for lazy saves. Immediate on panel close. BuildSaveData

g.title: TM
g.text: ITimeManager. CelestialTime, pause, day, season, year events

g.title: SV
g.text: ISaveService. JsonUtility to persistentDataPath, slot default

g.title: GI
g.text: Start: load or create save, then initialize every service

g.title: LEG
g.text: state dictionary, polled value, or read
points to the receiver of the data (dir=back means the arrow points at the owner)
